summary:
ITER 177 — Full backend + frontend verification of the three iter176 features (Life Goals, Import-from-File, Solution Finder decision_type + 4-sub-types consistency). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter176_lg_fileimport_sf.py. Frontend: all six review-request UI assertions PASS on mobile viewport 390x844 via https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com.

BACKEND DETAIL (super@test.com):
  • GET /api/life-goals/meta → sub_types order = ['Present Problem','Need','Future Risk','Aspiration'] ✓, 7 levels ✓, horizons=[quarter,1yr,3yr,5yr,10yr] ✓, life_areas non-empty ✓.
  • POST /api/life-goals timeline: requires title+horizon (∈ HORIZON_IDS)+life_area — all 4 negative paths return 400; happy path 200 with lg_mode='timeline'.
  • POST /api/life-goals tree: L1 ok, L1 with parent → 400, L2 without parent → 400, L3 with L1 as parent → 400 (parent must be exactly level-1), L5 without life_area → 400, L6 without sub_type → 400, L6 with bogus sub_type → 400. Built full L1→L7 chain; PUT title persists; DELETE L1 returns deleted≥7 and L7 follow-up GET returns 404 (cascade verified).
  • GET /api/life-goals?mode=tree, ?mode=tree&level=5, ?parent_id=<L1> all filter correctly. GET /api/life-goals/tree returns {levels[7], goals[]}.
  • GET /api/gem/goals lists every Life Goal we created with lg_mode='tree' (GEM linkage confirmed).
  • POST /api/file-import/decision/{id} (4-row VC CSV, ai_tier='fast', crawl_web=false): 200 with file_type='csv', factors_added+options_added>0, factors[] and options[] populated; follow-up GET /api/decisions/{id} confirms the decision's factors+candidates grew. Error paths: .zip → 400 ('Unsupported file…'), empty b64 → 400 ('uploaded file is empty'), 5-char 'hello' → 422 ('No readable text found…').
  • Solution Finder: POST then PUT decision_type='risk' → 200, follow-up GET preserves decision_type='risk'.

FRONTEND DETAIL (mobile 390x844, super@test.com → /admin landing, then deep-links):
  • /tools/pna shows 'My 360° Life' header with the subtitle literally rendering 'Present Problem · Need · Future Risk · Aspiration' (correct order). testIDs life-map-tab + life-goals-tab present. On 'Life Goals': both mode toggles 'By Life Area'(lg-mode-timeline) + '7-Level Tree'(lg-mode-tree) present. 7-Level Tree: 'Add Overall Life Goal (L1)' (lg-add-overall) present and an existing L1+L2 chain renders correctly. Timeline mode: per-area + buttons (lg-add-<area>) present; tapping one opens the modal with lg-title input and lg-save button.
  • Pros & Cons Wizard Step 1 'Basics' chip row order (DOM order) = ['pc-subtype-problem','pc-subtype-need','pc-subtype-risk','pc-subtype-aspiration'] — exact match. Screenshot confirms labels 'Present Problem | Need | Future Risk | Aspiration'.
  • Solution Finder Step 0 'Goal' chip row order (DOM order) = ['sf-subtype-problem','sf-subtype-need','sf-subtype-risk','sf-subtype-aspiration'] — exact match. Screenshot confirms identical labels.
  • MyDezider Step 2: import row's 'File' button (step2-import-file) renders. Tapping opens 'Import from File' modal with ALL six required controls: step2-file-pick ('Choose a file…'), step2-file-tier-fast (Cheap & Fast AI — selected by default), step2-file-tier-precise (Costly & Precise AI), step2-file-crawl-toggle ('Also research the web (AI crawl)'), step2-file-context (free-text Optional context input), and step2-file-import (Import primary button). Import button has aria-disabled='true' when no file is chosen — per review-request expectation. Real OS file picker is not drivable in headless browser, so end-to-end import via UI was not executed (the backend test already covers the import POST end-to-end).

No iter177-introduced regressions. No NEW Expo deprecations beyond the already-tracked chronic warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications web listener, TouchableWithoutFeedback) from iter176.

react_native_issues.issue: Chronic '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — not iter176/177-specific.
Chronic 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — not iter176/177-specific.
Chronic '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — informational only.

action_items: (NONE blocking) All three iter176 features verified end-to-end. Main agent can proceed without rework.
(low / chronic) Continue tracking RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, TouchableWithoutFeedback) for future cleanup pass.

(low) Consider letting POST /api/decisions accept either {title} or {title, context} — currently context is required (Pydantic 422) which surprised the testing-agent fixture but is fine for production UI.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/life_goals.py — clean. _public() strips _id; parent-validation enforces parent.lg_level == level-1; cascade delete uses BFS over parent_id frontier; L5 life_area + L6 sub_type guards present; uses LIFE_AREAS from routes.pna for the single source of truth.

routes/file_import.py — clean. Pydantic FileImportRequest, base64 decode wrapped in try/except, MAX_BYTES=8MB, blocking extraction off-thread (asyncio.to_thread), web enrichment is best-effort (failures swallowed so import still succeeds), AI metering via core.url_crawl.metered_chat with proper InsufficientCredits→402 mapping, and merge_into_mydezider returns counts that are echoed in the response.
routes/tools.py update_solution_finder — 'decision_type' is in the allowed list, so PUT persists and GET reflects it. Verified.

frontend/src/constants/decisionTypes.ts — DECISION_TYPES array order is exactly the user-mandated order: problem, need, risk, aspiration; both Pros & Cons (Step 1) and Solution Finder (Step 0) render the chips in this DOM order — confirmed via querySelector iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Life Goals UI, 4-sub-types chip order (PC + SF), and Step2 file-import modal render+disabled-state. Live file-pick via OS dialog not driven in headless browser (call-out only).

seed_data_creation: Backend test created (and cleaned up via cascade-delete for the L1 chain; 1 timeline goal left under super@test.com prefixed TEST_iter176; 1 decision 'TEST_iter176 file-import decision …' left for super@test.com with grown factors/options from the CSV import; 1 SF entry created and moved to Trash). All TEST_ prefixed for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns the token as 'session_token' (NOT 'access_token' or 'token'). Test fixture in /app/backend/tests/test_iter176_lg_fileimport_sf.py reads all three keys. Decisions POST requires {title, context} — context is non-optional via Pydantic. PRR step indicators on /prr/{decision_id} use testIDs step-dot-1 .. step-dot-10 (NOT step-1/step-2). Login submit button text is 'Sign In' (NOT 'Login'). For Life Goals UI, mode toggles render under /tools/pna → 'Life Goals' tab; tree mode shows lg-add-overall (L1) then lg-add-child-<id> on existing nodes. Step2 file-import modal's Import button uses aria-disabled (not the DOM disabled attribute) — when checking gating use .get_attribute('aria-disabled')=='true'. Expo is still on CI=true → restart expo + ~20s tunnel wait if main agent edits frontend during a session.
